assessments.reasoning: The Index’s pinned SCOPE.md [640,783) admits a documented modification to a base license. The Lazarus notice expressly modifies the Library GNU General Public License and retains each independent module’s license conditions.

The Lazarus project tree at b51eb6f0e87da578205ddcc993fe0674a8766178 supplies COPYING.modifiedLGPL.txt. Bytes [0,1097) identify the development team, covered units, header check, independence definition and optional extension to modifications. The captured file digest matches the claim.

The pinned Index decision [2776,3028) records 061c689ce91b4c88a7fe6f6904549ca3, Lazarus modified LGPL linking exception, lazarus-42-copying-modified-lgpl and sha256:0624a5291021279446fbea96cdd33527d09c64c87d5616f789b2521e2a9e3d71 with kind exception and editorial lifecycle active.

challenge.method: Compared the Lazarus witness with the Free Pascal RTL notice, the Index’s full GNU Classpath entry and a proposed project-wide reading.
challenge.results: The linking paragraphs are similar, but Lazarus identifies several Lazarus units, points to file headers and names COPYING.LGPL. Free Pascal identifies its RTL and packages and names COPYING. The full Classpath entry has another ID and revision. Those distinctions defeat both specimen substitutions and the project-wide reading.

limitations: The notice directs readers to each unit’s header and refers to COPYING.LGPL. The separately carried license text and a release tag were not among the supplied publisher originals. The inspected notice alone gives no numbered base edition or only-or-later election.
The short SPDX identifier is attested here by the Index’s cross-reference. The supplied evidence supports no independent formal SPDX match.
reasoning: The Lazarus project’s pinned notice identifies the covered units and grants conditional permission to link independent modules. The Index binds the exact Lazarus notice to its own permanent entity and assigns active.
